title: Extend the short-ID contract for branch-scoped tasks
description: Update the canonical task identifier contract to accept both legacy wtp-NNNN and scoped wtp-BBBBBBBB-NNNN forms, where B is exactly 8 lowercase hexadecimal characters and the sequence is at least four decimal digits. Add or expose a focused parser/classifier that lets flat-file code distinguish legacy IDs, extract a branch token, and read the numeric sequence without duplicating regex logic. Preserve every existing legacy validation behavior and improve error text/schema wording to name both accepted forms. Add core validation tests for valid boundary cases and malformed tokens, separators, casing, sequence widths, and unsafe filename-shaped input. Do not migrate existing Task.ShortID values.

comments.author: codex-wtp-loop
comments.message: Inspected repository guidance and the dependent branch-scope work. This task will add only the reusable dual-form short-ID parser/validation contract, focused core boundary/malformed-input tests, and authoritative schema wording; branch allocation, filename migration, scheduling, and existing ShortID values remain unchanged.

comments.author: codex-wtp-loop
comments.message: Implemented core.ParseShortID with a single anchored dual-form contract, legacy/scoped classification, branch ID extraction, and exact sequence text preservation. Task.Validate now uses it and names both accepted forms; embedded schema wording is updated. Focused core and CLI tests pass, with allocation, migration, and existing IDs unchanged.
